That arithmetic, built entirely from sibling numbers, directly resolves the mechanic q3 asks about and points decisively at option (c).

All 6 questions are classified source-supported, none source-determined. Spec §5.6 does not forbid this — the module is a knowledge-and-application test — but it does require the pack to be shown to be doing real work rather than decorating questions that would stand without it. That judgement is the reviewer's, and calibration across packs follows the repaired pilot.

A text-only pack in a familiar domain is the structurally hardest shape to make genuinely source-dependent, and the case where the line between source-supported and source-independent is thinnest. It warrants the closest reading of the four.
